fact: Both Member Designers independently approve the exact candidate version or report concrete blockers.
The Lead drafts one candidate, both members independently confirm it, and the Lead signs that version. Blocking findings route to Lead revision and member recheck.
Implement starts after the Lead signs the member-confirmed version and the plugin commits the design taskbook.
The signed archive records each addressed finding, its reviewer, the reviewed version, the evidence and the Lead resolution. T3 receives concise finding and revision summaries.
